integrity: An explicit four-case uniform proof and an independent exhaustive finite checker support the claims. The finite checks do not replace the proof. No claim of independent validation or confirmed publication priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Applies to connected one-hub clique bouquets with at least two blades, each of order at least two. All coefficients count labeled vertices. The earlier corona theorem already determines the scalar minimum; that scalar alone is not new. The 2019 introductory article full text was not accessible for a definitive comparison, and publication uniqueness is not established.
title: Outer-independent double Roman weight enumerators of heterogeneous clique bouquets
